An autistic student and the orientation leader were scheduled to speak at the freshman orientation this year to give students an idea of what to expect. All the students really appreciated the autistic student's presentation, but they were super surprised by how odd the orientation leader seemed in their presentation. Who gave a weird presentation?
A. The orientation leader
B. Not known
C. The autistic student
